description: This file contains a script for repairing the casing of database field names and associated metadata within SuiteCRM, specifically targeting the 'fields_meta_data' table and related view definitions. It ensures consistent lowercase naming for field identifiers across database entries and view configurations, primarily for admin users performing repairs or maintenance.

classes.name: RepairAndClear
classes.description: The script instantiates a RepairAndClear object to perform cache clearing and metadata rebuilding after the casing fixes.
